milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the blue concrete structure (centered at ~5,2,5 spawn-relative) and face toward it, confirming visual discovery. max_distance=6 prevents triggering from spawn (spawn-to-target distance is ~7.1) and requires actual movement toward the structure.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The oak wall sign is a small block at (5, 2, 4) on the south face of the blue concrete. max_distance=5 requires close inspection since signs are small and need proximity to visually identify. The player must face toward the sign's exact position.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The brown banner is elevated at (11, 5, 11) on top of a stone brick tower. max_distance=8 accounts for the banner being 5 blocks above ground level — the player needs to be reasonably close to the tower base to look up and visually confirm the banner. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the banner.
